definition.interpretation: The numerical observation indicates high measured stability (0.9), but as an unvalidated metric without an independent oracle, it only reflects instrument-reported sample means.
definition.limitations: Host-side evaluation does not establish causal preference formation or rule out artifactual correlation.
definition.next_step: Design a follow-up experiment testing record availability variability under controlled seeds.

definition.reason: Initial inconclusive results show stable correlations but lack independent validation.
definition.stop_condition: Reaching consistent correlation thresholds across independent trials.
definition.uncertainty: The causal link between durable record consistency and preference stability requires tighter experimental isolation.
